_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The directory picker caps rendering of huge directories and filters within them. On this phone-sized screen "the directory control" is in the overflow menu: when ".chat-overflow-popover" is not visible, first click the header's button with aria-label exactly "More options"; the control is then the button in ".chat-overflow-popover" whose accessible name starts with "Directory". The picker is ".modal.directory-picker-modal". {{BIG}} is a directory holding 520 subdirectories sub-0000 to sub-0519 and one named zz-needle. 1. Navigate to /new and click the directory control. 2. The picker should be visible. 3. Fill its ".directory-picker-input" with "{{BIG}}/". 4. There should be exactly 501 ".directory-picker-entry" elements in the picker (500 rows plus the ".." parent row), and ".directory-picker-truncated" should contain "more — type to filter". 5. Fill the input with "{{BIG}}/zz": there should be exactly 1 ".directory-picker-entry-name" (the ".." row has none), containing "zz-needle". 6. Press Escape: the picker count should become 0.
